remarks_1999: Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive indicates, "See gallery photograph." Verso dates 1935. Whitney Archive dates 1937. Dated 1935 on basis of inclusion in 1937–38 exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence, pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 67. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Red Camellia

description: The soft petals of a red and pink camellia fill the right side of the image. A dark green leaf springs out from the flower, which appears to be resting on a piece of rippling white fabric.
